post.summary: Create message and stream assistant response via SSE

post.description:
Uses one project gateway identity and auth surface, with explicit protocol-prefixed paths.
Use `/openai/chat/completions` or `/openai/responses` for OpenAI-compatible clients, and
`/anthropic/messages` or `/anthropic/messages/count_tokens` for Anthropic-compatible clients.
Creates a notebook message and, for user role, starts external-agent execution with streaming updates via /tasks/{taskId}/events.
Requests cancellation of the currently active notebook run.

task_relative_path.description: Relative path inside the notebook task working directory for execution-originated artifacts.

get.description: Server-Sent Events stream for notebook task execution updates (message/task_update/error/ping).

Returns execution trace events for a notebook task. Results can be scoped to a specific message or run,
and paged using cursor-style parameters (`after_id` / `before_id`).

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.description: Limit traces to a specific agent message.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: Limit traces to a specific task execution.

parameters.name: after_id
parameters.description: Return events newer than the given trace event id (gap-fill / tail paging).

parameters.name: before_id
parameters.description: Return events older than the given trace event id (load earlier logs).

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return.

has_more.description: Indicates older events are available for pagination.

next_after_id.description: Cursor for loading an earlier slice using `before_id`.

post.description:
Checks if a subject is authorized to perform an action on a resource.
This endpoint unifies permission checks, resource policy evaluation, and
project default settings into a single decision point.

Checks if a subject has sufficient limit remaining to perform an operation.
Returns limit status including remaining amount, limit, and reset time.

get.description:
Exports audit events in CSV or JSON format. Supports filtering by
time range, action, actor type, and other criteria.

post.description:
Creates a short-lived ticket for Server-Sent Events connections.
This prevents JWT tokens from being exposed in SSE URL query parameters.
Tickets are valid for approximately 5 minutes and are single-use.

get.summary: Get limit summary for all resources
get.description:
Returns limit usage summary across all resource types (endpoints, source libraries, agents).
Includes current usage, limits, percentage used, and reset times.

Returns time-series usage data for cost and limit tracking.
Supports filtering by metric type, time range, and granularity.

Returns aggregate usage record health for a time range, including
fallback hop distribution, error class counts, and estimated cost metrics.

Returns top providers/models/end users, anomaly peaks, and recent request outcomes
for the current usage filter scope.

Returns all alert rules for the project. Rules can be filtered by enabled status,
severity, and alert type.

post.description:
Creates a new alert rule for the project. The rule defines trigger conditions,
notification channels, and behavior settings.

get.description: Returns a single alert rule by ID

put.description: Updates an existing alert rule. Only provide fields that should be changed.

post.description:
Evaluates the alert rule against current data to check if it would trigger.
Returns the test result without actually sending any notifications.

get.description:
Returns alert notifications (triggered alert instances) for the project.
Supports filtering by status, time range, and rule.

put.description: Updates the status of an alert notification (e.g., mark as resolved or silenced).
